'''Doellin's Ring''' was a massive annular structure in located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Aygion Mountain]]. It served as the center of the planet's government, but was also a major tourist attraction. According to tradition, the Ring was built in the exact spot where the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Taya]] had told the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] to build a wall to keep out the evil [[Byllaya]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
